name: replay-debugger
title: Replay Debugger
description: A time-travel debugger with forward and reverse stepping, source navigation, breakpoints, logpoints, call stacks, scopes and expression evaluation. A plain DebuggerHost interface supplies data and callbacks; the included demo answers from an in-memory table, or from a real recording read once into JSON with Replay's native linker. A session of several recordings (a browser and the services behind it) plays on one timeline, with a flame chart of its distributed trace, each request's code, and the page as rrweb saw it.
